title: Rav Huna bar Minyomi

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Avodah Zarah 39a: he bought tekhelet from members of Rav Amram Chasida’s household and came before Rav Yosef (to ask whether he could trust them); he did not have [the answer]. Chanan the tailor met him and answered his question.
